changelog: New spoken-punctuation signs: with Spoken Punctuation on, say 'section sign' (or 'সেকশন চিহ্ন') while dictating and § appears ('see section sign 5' → 'see § 5'), and say 'paragraph sign' (or 'অনুচ্ছেদ চিহ্ন') and ¶ appears ('paragraph sign 3' → '¶ 3') — the formal-document pair for legal notices, applications and formal letters, instead of typing § or ¶ by hand. A bare 'section' or 'paragraph' still types as a word. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
